conversation.content: Let's start an operations record for the customer orders ingestion pipeline.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline", "value": {"pipeline_id": "customer_orders_ingestion"}}]
Have it run every 30 minutes so the rest of the operating targets can be based on that cadence.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/schedule", "value": {"interval_minutes": 30}}]
Set the freshness commitment to be fifteen minutes longer than the run cadence.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/freshness_sla", "value": {"formula": "freshness_sla_minutes = interval_minutes + 15", "minutes": 45}}]
Allow retries to keep going for twice the run cadence before the run is treated as exhausted.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/retry_window", "value": {"formula": "retry_window_minutes = interval_minutes * 2", "minutes": 60}}]
For consumers, note that refreshed outputs should be expected five minutes after each run cadence completes.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/downstream_refresh_expectation", "value": {"formula": "downstream_expected_refresh_minutes = interval_minutes + 5", "minutes": 35}}]
Also trigger stale-data paging when the latest successful load is twenty minutes older than the cadence target.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/stale_data_alert_threshold", "value": {"formula": "stale_data_alert_threshold_minutes = interval_minutes + 20", "minutes": 50}}]
Add a short purpose note saying it keeps the warehouse order tables current for analytics and support teams.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/description", "value": "Keeps warehouse order tables current for analytics and support teams."}]
Assign Dana from data engineering as the primary person to contact for this pipeline.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/owners", "value": [{"name": "Dana Patel", "team": "data engineering", "role": "primary"}]}]
Add Miguel from platform operations as the backup contact in case Dana is unavailable.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/owners/-", "value": {"name": "Miguel Santos", "team": "platform operations", "role": "backup"}}]
Note that the input comes from the production orders table in Shopify.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/source", "value": {"system": "Shopify", "database": "orders_prod", "table": "orders"}}]
Send the cleaned results to the analytics warehouse orders mart.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/destination", "value": {"system": "Snowflake", "database": "analytics_wh", "table": "mart_orders"}}]
Mark the orchestrator as Airflow in the production environment.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/runtime", "value": {"orchestrator": "Airflow", "environment": "production"}}]
Use UTC, anchor the cadence at midnight, and don’t apply daylight-saving adjustments.

[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/schedule/timezone", "value": "UTC"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/schedule/anchor_time", "value": "00:00"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/schedule/daylight_saving_observed", "value": false}]
Record the Airflow identifier and note that catch-up runs should stay disabled.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/runtime/dag_id", "value": "customer_orders_ingestion_dag"}, {"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/runtime/catchup_enabled", "value": false}]
Please have operational alerts go to the data-platform Slack room under a P1 paging policy.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/notifications", "value": {"slack_channel": "#data-platform", "severity": "P1", "paging_policy": "orders-ingestion-primary"}}]
Include the runbook link and the dashboard people should check during incidents.

[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/operations_links", "value": {"runbook_url": "https://runbooks.example.com/customer-orders-ingestion", "dashboard_url": "https://grafana.example.com/d/orders-ingestion"}}]
Add a validation that rejects loads when any order record is missing its identifier.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/quality_checks", "value": [{"name": "order_id_not_null", "condition": "order_id IS NOT NULL", "action": "fail_load"}]}]
Also make sure duplicate order identifiers stop the load rather than letting conflicting rows through.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/quality_checks/-", "value": {"name": "order_id_unique", "condition": "COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)", "action": "fail_load"}}]
Add a transformation step that normalizes currency amounts before the records land in the warehouse.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/transformations", "value": [{"name": "normalize_currency_amounts", "tool": "dbt", "status": "enabled"}]}]
Include another enabled cleanup step that standardizes customer email casing.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/transformations/-", "value": {"name": "standardize_customer_email_case", "tool": "dbt", "status": "enabled"}}]
Capture the incremental loading approach using the order update timestamp and a ten-minute overlap.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/incremental_strategy", "value": {"mode": "watermark", "watermark_column": "updated_at", "lookback_minutes": 10}}]
Set the retry behavior to make three attempts, wait five minutes between them, and avoid exponential backoff.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/retry_policy", "value": {"max_attempts": 3, "delay_minutes": 5, "exponential_backoff": false}}]
Store the warehouse table partitioned by order date and clustered by customer account for query performance.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/storage_layout", "value": {"partition_by": "order_date", "cluster_by": "customer_id", "retention_days": 730}}]
Limit warehouse write permissions to the engineering service account, while analysts should only be able to read the published table.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/access_control", "value": {"writer_principal": "svc_airflow_orders", "reader_group": "analytics_readers", "pii_access_required": false}}]
Classify the data as internal and note that payment card details are not included.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/data_governance", "value": {"classification": "internal", "contains_pci": false}}]
Add lineage notes showing the upstream feed name and the published dataset name consumers recognize.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/lineage", "value": {"upstream_feed": "shopify_orders_cdc", "published_dataset": "orders_mart", "catalog_visible": true}}]
Record the deployment details for the current release branch and image version.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/deployment", "value": {"git_branch": "main", "image_tag": "orders-ingestion-2024.11.3", "release_channel": "stable"}}]
Add cost tracking for the compute pool, with the monthly budget in dollars and the finance tag.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/cost_tracking", "value": {"warehouse_size": "medium", "monthly_budget_usd": 1200, "cost_center": "FIN-OPS-042"}}]
Track recent maintenance by noting the last review date, who approved it, and the next review date.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/maintenance", "value": {"last_reviewed_on": "2024-11-15", "approved_by": "Dana Patel", "next_review_on": "2025-02-15"}}]
Note that historical reloads can go back one year and must be manually approved before they start.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/backfill_policy", "value": {"max_history_days": 365, "requires_approval": true, "approval_group": "data-governance"}}]
Add the first consumer dependency for the finance team’s revenue reporting job.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/downstream_dependencies", "value": [{"name": "revenue_reporting_job", "owner_team": "finance analytics", "criticality": "high"}]}]
Also list the support team's order status dashboard as a medium-priority consumer.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/downstream_dependencies/-", "value": {"name": "order_status_dashboard", "owner_team": "customer support", "criticality": "medium"}}]
Add observability settings so each run emits metrics, keeps logs for ninety days, and tags traces with the order ingestion service name.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/observability", "value": {"metrics_enabled": true, "log_retention_days": 90, "trace_service": "orders-ingestion"}}]
Add encryption settings for the warehouse data at rest and in transit, using the managed key for this pipeline.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/encryption", "value": {"at_rest": true, "in_transit": true, "kms_key_alias": "alias/orders-ingestion"}}]
Record the incident process with the escalation team, target acknowledgement time, and where postmortems should be filed.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/incident_response", "value": {"escalation_team": "data platform on-call", "ack_target_minutes": 10, "postmortem_folder": "ops/postmortems/orders-ingestion"}}]
Add the service-level reporting details, including the monthly review audience, the scorecard name, and the reporting owner.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/service_reporting", "value": {"review_cadence": "monthly", "scorecard": "orders_pipeline_health", "owner_team": "data engineering"}}]
Capture who to contact for vendor-side source outages, including the partner name, support email, and contract tier.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/vendor_support", "value": {"partner": "Shopify Plus", "support_email": "plus-support@shopify.example", "contract_tier": "enterprise"}}]
Please also capture who handles audits, where the evidence is stored, and that it should be kept for seven years.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/pipeline/audit", "value": {"owner_team": "compliance engineering", "evidence_repository": "s3://company-audit-evidence/orders-ingestion", "retention_years": 7}}]

edit_instruction: Change the pipeline’s run cadence to every 45 minutes.
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a scheduled pipeline whose run interval determines freshness SLA, retry window, downstream expected refresh time, and stale-data alert threshold by arithmetic rules written explicitly in the artifact (state each formula, e.g. freshness_sla = interval + 15). Around this core, add the realistic, independent details an operations record would carry that do not depend on the schedule interval, and vary their number from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Change the pipeline schedule interval to a different specific interval.
cascade_pattern: Editing the interval re-derives the SLA, retry window, downstream refresh expectation, and stale-data alert threshold from the stated formulas. Owners, descriptions, and fields that do not read the interval stay unchanged.

annotation_notes: interval 30->45; freshness=45+15=60, retry=45*2=90, refresh=45+5=50, stale=45+20=65 per stated formulas. owners/source/dest/... unrelated.
